bio: This establishment is located inside the DiamAndes winery, where they say that ‘nothing exceptional can be achieved without an exceptional terroir.’ After this statement, which takes on new meaning when you see its splendid facilities, the commitment to the environment and the Mendoza region is even more understandable. In this regard, and among many other details, it is interesting to know that they are members of the famous Clos de los Siete and have a gravity winemaking system. The most striking feature of the restaurant, located on the first floor and with spectacular views of both the Andes Mountains and the vineyards, is chef Santiago Orozco Russo’s elaborate proposal, who has been able to create a gastronomic concept that mixes meaning, flavour and flashes of creativity. You will find a small à la carte (designed for a more informal meal) and two carefully selected tasting menus: Petit Grand Cru and Grand Cru, both of which include a visit to the winery.
